scope: Declared cluster application/runner paths only; excludes arbitrary scripts, host execution and public-data preparation on an operator workstation.

conditions.util-linux: No privileged mount or block-device probing path; non-root, all capabilities dropped, no privilege escalation, RuntimeDefault seccomp, no host/device mounts.
conditions.sqlite3: Management uses verified PostgreSQL; stub and pinned AIPerf/runner paths do not accept SQLite databases, SQL, FTS tables or changesets.
conditions.glibc: C locale is explicitly frozen; request/configuration content cannot set process locale variables or supply message catalogs.
conditions.zlib: No non-blocking gzwrite/gzprintf/gzvprintf path. Python compression and Nginx's HTTP compression do not invoke that API sequence.
